name: Theophylline
indications_original: Theophylline extended-release tablets are indicated for the treatment of the symptoms and reversible airflow obstruction associated with chronic asthma and other chronic lung diseases, e.g., emphysema and chronic bronchitis.
contraindications_original:
Taking theophylline extended-release tablets immediately after a high-fat content meal may result in a somewhat higher C
 
  maxand delayed T
 
  maxand somewhat greater extent of absorption. However, the differences are usually not great and this product may normally be administered without regard to meals (see
 
  CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY, Drug Interactions, Drug-Food Interactions).

 
                  Theophylline extended-release tablets are recommended for chronic or long-term management and prevention of symptoms, and not for use in treating acute symptoms of asthma and reversible bronchospasm.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Theophylline Extended-release Tablets:
                  
                  
                     450 mg:White to off-white, capsule shaped, uncoated tablet, debossed with 'T' and '2' separated with a functional scoring on one side and plain on the other side.

 
                   
                  NDC 72789-442-01     Bottle of 100
                  Dispense in a well-closed container with child resistant closure [as defined in the USP].
                  Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature].
adverseReactions_original: Theophylline extended-release tablets are contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to theophylline or other components in the product.
